## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The retry cap must be fixed before merge because an upstream outage can trigger more attempts than project policy allows.

## Changes

The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry`, unit tests, and a text fixture. It also raises the documented retry cap from five to ten attempts.

## Critical

- app/net.py:19 — correctness — Enforce the five-attempt retry cap — When an upstream keeps returning HTTP 503, a default call makes ten attempts, exceeding `AGENTS.md:5`, which says “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” The range check also accepts explicit counts from six through ten. — During a sustained outage, each extra attempt adds load and delays the error the caller needs to handle. — Fix: Set the default and upper bound to five, align the documentation, and update `test_fetch_with_retry_default_attempt_count` and `test_fetch_with_retry_rejects_attempts_outside_range`.
